notes.title: New Features + Fixes
notes.content:
Hello racers!

Below is a list of the features and fixes that were added to [url=store.steampowered.com/app/446100/Mantis_Burn_Racing/]Mantis Burn Racing®[/url] in a [b]recent patch[/b], which you may have noticed and, hopefully, have already downloaded. 

The update includes the further expansion of the already epic single-player career, plus rebalancing to inlcude the post-launch DLC tracks and events. We've also added a new 
[b]Spectator Mode[/b] to online races which you may appreciate, this is also useful when integrating eSports tournaments into the game. Further updates will be forthcoming in the near future, including an exciting new game mode!

[b]New Features[/b] 
[list]
  [*] Added Elite Seasons 2 & 3 - featuring 24 new events for advanced players.
  [*] Enhanced Career – All career seasons have been re-balanced to better integrate tracks and events that were added in post-launch DLC packs.
  [*] Spectator Mode – Players can now spectate online races as well as race.
    [*] Added Online Lobby Countdown – Timer counts down as soon as the host has readied-up, enabling players to get into online races without delay. 
  [*] Added Japanese Text Localisation – The game now supports Japanese language.

[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b] 
[list]
  [*] Extensive online connectivity improvements.
  [*] Game freezing with no UI displayed on garage screen fixed.
  [*] Frame rate optimizations.
  [*] German and Dutch language translation optimisations.
  [*] General bug fixing.

[/list]
Thanks for playing and please continue to give us your feedback!

[b]-VooFoo[/b]

notes.title: Massive Mantis Burn Racing® Update Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25558491/092ba948e410ea197d57f03643896f3c87d9ea60.png[/img]

Hello race fans!

The latest game update for [b]Mantis Burn Racing®[/b] is here, and it’s a big one! As ever, we’ve been listening to your comments and feedback and we’re delighted to be able to now release a patch that brings many fan-requested features and improvements to the game. 

The update includes improvements to performance during online play and improved loading times, which we know have been popular requests. Significantly, we've also added cross-play which will allow Steam players to connect with console players, which we hope improves the online experience for you all!  Elsewhere, there’s now a ‘Random Event’ option for online races and the game now indicates whether upgrades are on / off for the Weekly Challenges. 

The update is available now on STEAM and you can read the full patch notes, below. Please continue to let us know your feedback; we hope you enjoy the improvements.

[*] Comprehensive improvements in usability and performance during online play
[*] Improved loading times
[*] Vehicle collision improvements and bug fixes
[*] AI driven vehicles now use their boost more intelligently
[*] Added upgrade on/off information to Weekly Challenge 
[*] New ‘Random Event’ option for online races
[*] New ‘Great’, ‘Amazing’ and ‘Awesome’ Sector XP rewards replace ‘Clean Sector’
[*] Track name and map shown during loading
[*] Gear Challenges now turn red as soon as they are failed
[*] Garage appearance tweaks
[*] General performance improvements
[*] Cross play allowing online players to connect with players on other platforms
[*] Added the ability to adjust HDR brightness on HDR enabled TV’s
[*] General bug fixes

See you out on the tracks!

[b]VooFoo[/b]

notes.title: Mantis Burn Racing® Update! Online Improvements, Single-Screen Multiplayer and More!
notes.content:
Hello!

We've pushed live an update for [b]Mantis Burn Racing®[/b]  which we hope you’ll enjoy!

We want to encourage and support the multiplayer community, so we’re really pleased to introduce a new lobby system that we hope helps bring players together online; we’ve also added the ability to race online with AI drivers as well as enhancing online stability, overall. For players requesting single-screen multiplayer, we’ve added a new ‘Spotlight’ event which pits players in a battle to remain within the spotlight and be the final racer standing! We’ve also made some improvements to the engine audio sounds which we appreciate some people have been asking for. 

We’re working on further improvements and new content right now, so thanks for playing and be sure to keep an eye on the forum or follow us on Twitter [b]@VooFoo[/b]  for all our news and updates.


[b]Here are the patch notes in full:[/b]
   
[*]New Spotlight event added - Play single-screen multiplayer in a battle to remain within the spotlight and be the final racer standing!
[*]AI drivers can now be selected to fill the grid of online races
[*]Extensive online stability improvements
[*]Improved online lobby structure to allow players to race against AI while their lobby fills with human opponents
[*]Frame rate performance enhancements
[*]Extensive engine audio enhancements
[*]General bug fixes and polish
[*]Fixed a potential crash when changing screen resolution
[*]Minor cosmetic bug fixes.

Thank you!

[b]VooFoo[/b]

notes.title: Mantis Burn Racing - Update live!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Thanks for all your feedback since the full version of the game went live a few weeks ago -  We've just pushed live an update that makes a number of improvements to the game and includes a few bug fixes. Please let us know if you have any questions or comments and do give us your feedback on the update! We're continuing to listen to your feedback and will be putting out further updates to add new content in the coming weeks and months. 

 [b]Here are the update details in full:[/b]
[*]‘Punching above your weight’, ‘The bigger they are..’ and ‘I’ll bring it back without a    scratch’ achievements now never blocked from being unlocked
[*] Improved online lobby creation
[*]New ‘Far’ camera option
[*]Players XP level now displayed in online lobbies
[*]Gear reward summary now shown post-race
[*]Online leader board now shown post-race
[*]Improved car-to-car collision physics
[*]Mechanic tutorials added for Overtake and Hotlap events as well as x2 upgrades
[*]Boost colour now shown dynamically in the garage
[*]Improved vehicle stat bar calculation
[*]Option to permanently show players gamer-tag above their vehicle
[*]Ability to fast switch between career seasons
[*]Highlighted career events now auto-scroll when joystick held in any direction
[*]Time bonus for overtaking vehicles in the weekly Overtake challenge
[*] XP line UI graphic tweaks
[*]Weekly challenge distance units now change dynamically with player’s selection
[*]Overtake bug fixed that could cause the event to end prematurely
[*]Improved logic for vehicle overtaking
[*]AI tweaks
[*]Audio tweaks
[*] General bug fixes and polish

Thanks for playing! 

 [b]@VooFoo[/b]
